title: Single violation: short a symbol that isn't shortable
notes: No existing GME position; a sell order with no covering long position is a short sale. market.assets[GME].shortable is false (hard to borrow), so R7 fires, BLOCKING. There is no repair for an eligibility failure -- you either can borrow the shares or you can't -- so the basket BLOCKs. Zero orders reach the broker.
